name: repo-platform-add-module
description: Add or remove a repo-platform module in a managed repository: edit the selection, set module parameters, review the sync PR, and finish the companion steps.

interface.shortDescription: Change a managed repository's repo-platform module selection.
interface.longDescription: The playbook for module changes in a repo-platform managed repository: the repo-owned modules list in .repo-platform.yml, module parameters recorded in .github/.copier-answers.yml, the sync PR that renders the change, each module's companion steps (labels, secrets, one-time setup), and what removal cleans up vs leaves behind.
